restoreRecipe: git log --oneline chat-only -- <path> ; git revert <sha>   (main is never merged into; every phase is its own commit)

entries.name: relay as a default transport
entries.why: the public/free relay must not be a default path; Tailscale address or a Cloudflare tunnel only. The relay/ source directory (79 tracked files) is KEPT in git and is not deleted.
entries.restore: Phase 1's own commit (the one that removed relay-as-default). Use `git log --oneline chat-only -- mobile/src/lib/quic.ts backend/convex/devices.ts backend/convex/schema.ts desktop/agent/connection_preferences.go` then `git revert <sha>`.

entries.name: the non-Chat, non-Machines screens
globs: mobile/app/**/*.tsx excluding mobile/app/(tabs)/tasks.tsx, mobile/app/(tabs)/devices.tsx, mobile/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx, mobile/app/index.tsx, mobile/app/login.tsx, mobile/app/connection.tsx, mobile/app/secure-handoff.tsx
entries.restore: Phase 2's own commit (the one that removed the extra mobile screens). Use `git log --oneline chat-only -- 'mobile/app/**/*.tsx'` then `git revert <sha>`.

entries.name: claude and codex runner plumbing
entries.restore: Phase 3's own commit (the one that removed the claude/codex runner plumbing). Use `git log --oneline chat-only -- 'desktop/agent/claude_*.go' 'desktop/agent/codex_*.go' desktop/agent/acp_runner.go desktop/agent/agent_mode.go desktop/agent/agent_runner_resume.go desktop/agent/ai_generator.go` then `git revert <sha>`.

entries.name: Convex functions and tables OAuth does not need
entries.why: no backend beyond OAuth sign-in; code only, NO live data and NO Convex deploy
entries.restore: Phase 4's own commit (the one that removed the unused Convex functions and tables). Use `git log --oneline chat-only -- 'backend/convex/*.ts' 'backend/convex/*.mts' 'backend/convex/*.mjs'` then `git revert <sha>`. Never deploy Convex to restore it; revert only.

entries.name: web dashboard destinations and CLI runner verbs
entries.restore: Phase 5's own commit (the one that removed the web dashboard destinations and CLI runner verbs). Use `git log --oneline chat-only -- 'web/app/**' 'web/components/dashboard/**' 'cli/**/*.go'` then `git revert <sha>`.

entries.name: proof steps
entries.why: not a removal; the type checks, Yaver's tests and the one simulator screenshot that prove the rest.
entries.restore: Phase 6's own commit (the proof steps; nothing is removed by it, so a revert only drops the proof commands and the screenshot artifact). Use `git log --oneline chat-only` then `git revert <sha>`.
